summary: Full stack testing of Byvision Sales Performance app. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests PASSED (auth VAGNER/admin, RBAC 403, dashboard shape/city filter/KPI math, client detail, meta CRUD w/ persistence, status). Frontend (mobile 390x844): login screen, VAGNER dashboard, KPI cards, progress ring, 21 city chips filter, 59 client rows navigation, client detail with monthly chart & purchases, settings theme toggle (light/dark/system), logout, admin login with admin-button visible, admin metas edit with 59 meta-inputs and save button - ALL working. Admin button correctly hidden for VAGNER (RBAC UI). One minor observation: after logout->login as admin within same page session (SPA), the admin-button did not render until a page refresh; on a fresh session it renders correctly. Non-blocking. Console shows only a benign RN-web warning: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'.

ui_bugs.issue: After logging out and logging back in as admin in the same SPA session, the admin-button (tune-variant) is not rendered until the page is reloaded. Fresh session works. Likely stale user state in auth context or React Query cache not cleared on logout.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking on web preview but should be migrated for future RN versions.

action_items: (LOW) On logout, clear the auth user state and invalidate/reset the React Query cache so that a subsequent login as a different role (e.g. admin) renders role-specific UI (admin-button) without needing a page reload.
(LOW) Migrate any RN styles using shadow* props to boxShadow to remove the deprecation warning on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which are deprecated in modern FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers (not blocking).
auth.py: bcrypt/JWT flow implemented correctly, tokens verified, RBAC via require_role works (verified 403 for vendedor on /admin/metas).
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded in dashboard/clients/metas queries via projection {'_id': 0}.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused seeded users (admin, VAGNER) and 59 clients synced from DW. Meta update test restores the original value after PUT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Credentials: VAGNER/vagner123 (vendedor, cod 204), admin/admin123. pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_byvision_api.py exercises all critical flows including RBAC and persistence via GET-after-PUT. Reference period is set/2026, total meta ~R$87.868. On fresh login KPIs: realizado ~R$24.579,28 / provisionado ~R$47.928,00 / gap R$23.348,72 / 12 de 22 dias uteis / 21 cidades / 59 clientes.
rca_of_issue: Minor UI issue: admin-button hidden after logout->login-as-admin flow (no reload). Reproduction: 1) Login as VAGNER, 2) go to settings, 3) tap logout, 4) at login screen enter admin/admin123, 5) after redirect to /dashboard the admin-button is missing. Mitigation: on logout, call setUser(null) AND queryClient.clear()/removeQueries so subsequent login refreshes user context and role-conditional UI. Reloading the page after login resolves it.
